entries.notes: All nine TypeScript declarations are translated. Coverage preserves exact in-flight preparation sharing; synchronous preparer normalization; speculative rejection retention until the ordered consumer observes it; retry only after observation; concurrent workflow/result/error/hook prewarming; cached decrypt/decompress work with fresh VM object revival; stale-snapshot resetScan behavior for events inserted below the scanned prefix; event-ID keyed reuse across rescans; legacy flattened-value bypass; missing event-data tolerance; memoization of share-safe primitives including undefined; the 4096-character cap; fresh hydration for mutable and oversized values; and retry after failed hydration. Security-relevant cases prevent mutable object graphs from crossing VM boundaries, prevent stale-snapshot insertions from escaping preparation, and prevent speculative prewarming from hiding the original decryption failure. Final GREEN must exercise the production Rust payload preparer, authenticated decryption/decompression, event scanner, VM reviver, and failure-eviction ordering; scenario-specific observations are insufficient.
